01 · Brand FoundationPYLE
Tone of Voice

Talk like a friend who knows gear.

Core rules

  • Lead with the passion, then the proof
  • Short and active: “you”, not “users”
  • Real, verified numbers only
  • One wink per piece. Never in legal copy
DoDon’t
“Weatherproof to IP67”“Totally waterproof!”
“100 W peak / 50 W RMS”“Massive 1000 W!!!”
“Designed in the USA”“Made in the USA”
“Plug in. Turn up. Get into it!”“Buy NOW or miss out!”

02 · Logo SystemPYLE
Clearspace & Minimum Size

Give it room to be loud.

X = width of the P’s vertical stem. Minimum clearspace = 1X on all sides · No elements may enter this zone.

Minimum size

  • Wordmark: 20 mm / 80 px width
  • Stacked: 10 mm / 32 px width
  • Badge: 12 mm / 48 px diameter

Incorrect use

  • Do not stretch, skew, or distort proportions
  • Do not recolor outside approved palettes
  • Do not place over busy or low-contrast backgrounds
  • Do not rotate or angle the wordmark

“Designed in the USA” Badge

An endorsement, never a headline.

On Light / Cream

On Pyle Red

Rules & Placements

  • Always “Designed in the USA”. Never alter it to “Made in”
  • Always show the actual country of manufacture (e.g., Made in China) on consumer packaging

Minimum size

12 mm / 48 px diameter

Approved placements

E-commerce listings · retail product packaging · brand collateral · brand endcards

05 · Imagery & Visual AssetsPYLE
Graphic System

The Pulse of Play

The heartbeat of Pyle. Radiating sound into every space.
MeaningSound you don’t just hear, but feel.
ConstructionConcentric, evenly spaced rings. Stroke width = gap.
MotionA gentle 1–2 second outward pulse, eased and looped.

Appendix A · Regional RequirementsPYLE
🇨🇦 Canada · Language & Quebec

Bilingual, coast to coast.

Nationwide

English and French on every Canadian pack.

Quebec

French on pack, manuals, website, checkout and support. Add the “CONÇU AUX ÉTATS-UNIS” badge.

Trademarks

“PYLE” stays. Translate descriptive words: “Système de haut-parleurs”.

French taglines · for review
Embarque!
Ton prochain coup de cœur.
PYLE Brand Guidelines | Prepared by 48 Hour Digital
Appendix A · Regional RequirementsPYLE
🇨🇦 Canada · Pricing, consent & marks

Prices before tax, like the US.

Pricing

  • Shown before tax, in CAD
  • Tax added at checkout by province
  • French format: 49,99 $

Email & SMS

  • Opt-in first, no pre-ticked boxes
  • Unsubscribe link in every message

Pack marks

  • IC number on wireless products
  • cUL, cETL or CSA on plug-in products
  • Warnings in English and French
PYLE Brand Guidelines | Prepared by 48 Hour Digital
Appendix A · Regional RequirementsPYLE
🇪🇺 European Union · Pricing & returns

The price you see is the price you pay.

VAT included

Every price, everywhere. Format: 49,99 €

Honest discounts

Show the lowest price from the last 30 days.

14-day returns

Any reason, with a clear “Withdraw” button.

Approved copyYou can withdraw from this purchase within 14 days of receiving it, without giving a reason. We’ll refund everything you paid, including standard delivery, within 14 days.

Appendix A · Regional RequirementsPYLE
🇦🇺 Australia · Pricing & guarantees

Guarantees you can’t sign away.

Mandatory warranty text · word for wordOur goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. You are entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure and compensation for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage. You are also entitled to have the goods repaired or replaced if the goods fail to be of acceptable quality and the failure does not amount to a major failure.

10% GST included

One total price, shown as $49.99

Never write

  • “No refunds”
  • “All sales final”
  • “Warranty void if…”
